description: Foundation fixes that the live Mission Control UI and the debrief Astro-AI summary depend on, with NO simulation-layer change. (1) Fix R3: the store's decisionLog is empty during a mission (only filled at endMission) — extend mission-store.updateFromSimResult to accept an optional decisionLog and have useMissionControl pass engine.getDecisionLog() after every successful step, and store initialResources so Astro-AI can compute resource percentages. (2) Add AstroAssistant.getMissionSummary() + a mission-summary prompt + a mission-partial knowledge-base entry + barrel export. (3) Add a useAstroContext hook that builds a SimulationContext from the store + planet profiles + initialResources. Update the store/hook/AI unit tests accordingly. Independent of FEAT-001 (no UI), but ordered here so FEAT-004 (Mission Control) and FEAT-005 (debrief) get a live log and the summary method.
steps: src/store/mission-store.ts: add `initialResources: ResourceSnapshot | null` (null) to MissionState and INITIAL_MISSION_STATE; add action setInitialResources(resources: ResourceSnapshot). Extend updateFromSimResult(result: SimulationResult, decisionLog?: readonly DecisionLogEntry[]) to set decisionLog when provided; replace the misleading comment with one stating the hook passes engine.getDecisionLog() on every step. resetMission already spreads INITIAL_MISSION_STATE so it clears initialResources.

src/hooks/useMissionControl.ts: in initializeMission, after computing initialResources, call missionStore.getState().setInitialResources(initialResources) before startMission(). In advanceDay/resolveEvent/emergencyRation success branches, pass engineRef.current!.getDecisionLog() (non-null, just null-checked) as the second arg: missionStore.getState().updateFromSimResult(result.value, log). No src/simulation/ change — only the hook calls the existing engine method.

src/ai/astro-assistant.ts: add `async getMissionSummary(context: SimulationContext): Promise<AstroResponse>`. Map context.outcome -> fallback trigger: 'success'->'mission-success', 'failure'->'mission-failure', 'partial'->'mission-partial', else 'default'. Build prompt via buildMissionSummaryPrompt(context); return this.callAI(prompt, trigger). Never throws (callAI falls back to the knowledge base).

src/ai/prompts/mission-summary.prompt.ts: export buildMissionSummaryPrompt(context: SimulationContext) following the pattern of src/ai/prompts/event-explanation.prompt.ts (formatContext helper, age-appropriate 8-12, no invented numbers, instruct a JSON object matching AstroResponseSchema). NO React/Zustand imports.

src/ai/knowledge-base.ts: add a 'mission-partial' KnowledgeEntry (good-effort, learning-focused tone, NASA-sourced scienceFact, a suggestion to review the decision log) near the existing mission-success/mission-failure entries.
src/ai/index.ts: export buildMissionSummaryPrompt from the new prompt module.

src/hooks/useAstroContext.ts: returns SimulationContext | null. Read useMissionControl selectors (selectedPlanetId, crewSize, baseConfig, currentResources, currentMissionDay, activeEventIds, activeFaultStates, missionOutcome, missionActive) and initialResources from the store. Look up the profile (selectedPlanetId === 'moon' ? MOON_PROFILE : MARS_PROFILE) for displayName/timeUnitLabel. Reconstruct a SimulationState (seed: 0 — not used by the context) and call buildSimulationContext(state, null, profile.displayName, profile.timeUnitLabel, initialResources). Return null if !missionActive or any required datum is null. (Importing the profile objects is read-only data access; importing buildSimulationContext from @ai is allowed.)

tests/unit/store/mission-store.test.ts: assert updateFromSimResult(result, log) sets decisionLog; assert setInitialResources sets it; assert resetMission clears initialResources (it already resets to INITIAL).
tests/unit/hooks/useMissionControl.test.ts: assert decisionLog is non-empty after advanceDay (not only after endMission); assert initialResources is set after initializeMission.
tests/unit/ai/astro-assistant.test.ts: add getMissionSummary cases for success/failure/partial outcomes — each returns a Zod-valid AstroResponse (offline fallback, no fetch).
acceptance_criteria: mission-store.updateFromSimResult(result, decisionLog) sets decisionLog when provided; setInitialResources exists; resetMission clears initialResources
useMissionControl.advanceDay/resolveEvent/emergencyRation pass engine.getDecisionLog() to updateFromSimResult on success; initializeMission stores initialResources
AstroAssistant.getMissionSummary exists, never throws, and returns a Zod-valid AstroResponse for each outcome (offline fallback)
buildMissionSummaryPrompt is exported from @ai; knowledge-base has a mission-partial entry
useAstroContext returns null before mission start and a valid SimulationContext after
All existing tests remain green; the updated/new store/hook/AI tests pass
verification: npm run build exits 0 with zero TS errors (and no src/simulation/ change)
npm run test -- --run passes (91 existing + updated store/hook/AI tests)
git diff --name-only shows no src/simulation/ path
